title: chat-server: Chat state does not change when unreadCount changes
description: Chat.unreadCount is computed on every Chat/get since JMAP-y3f2.4 (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L547-548), but Message/set create/destroy and ReadPosition/set do not advance the Chat state token. RFC 8620 §5.1: 'If the data changes, this string MUST change'; §ReadPosition/set L1351 says the server 'recomputes Chat.unreadCount for the affected Chat'. A client syncing Chats via Chat/changes never learns the count changed. Fix: record a Chat update (state bump + change entry with the Chat id) whenever a Message create/destroy or a ReadPosition update changes a Chat's count. Found while implementing JMAP-y3f2.4.
close_reason: Landed in already fixed (f5838646, 336a3c5e under JMAP-y3f2.4) (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
